resources.string: Your phone can put HONE firmware on your Flipper. Use a USB-C cable if you have one; otherwise Bluetooth works too. Your Flipper keeps working the whole time and nothing is lost.
No Flipper found. Plug in the USB cable, or pair it over Bluetooth.
This app build has no firmware release key yet, so it will not install anything. Update the app first.
Safe to stop: your Flipper only changes after every file has been checked.
1. On the Flipper: Settings → Bluetooth → On.\n2. On the phone, tap “Open Bluetooth settings” and pick your Flipper.\n3. The Flipper shows a 6-digit code. Check it matches the phone and tap Pair.
Connect the phone and Flipper with a USB-C cable. Allow HONE to use the USB device when asked. No pairing needed.
Your Flipper runs the official firmware
HONE firmware is optional. It adds HONE sensing and keeps the usual Flipper apps. You can go back to the official firmware at any time.
I want to install HONE firmware
Installs the official Flipper firmware with the same checks. Your SD card files stay. You can also use qFlipper on a computer.
Keep the phone and Flipper close until this finishes.

string-array.name: howto_apk_steps
string-array.item: On your Android phone, open honemesh.net/app.
Tap “Download the app”.
When the phone asks, allow your browser to install apps.
Open the downloaded file and tap Install.
Open HONE and allow the permissions it explains.

string-array.name: howto_usb_steps
string-array.item: Charge the Flipper to at least 30%, or keep it plugged in.
Connect the phone and the Flipper with a USB-C cable.
In HONE, open Devices → Flipper → Install / update HONE firmware.
Allow HONE to use the USB device.
Tap Install and keep the cable in until the Flipper restarts.
Done: HONE shows the new version.

string-array.name: howto_ble_steps
string-array.item: On the Flipper: Settings → Bluetooth → On.
On the phone: Bluetooth settings → pick your Flipper → check the 6-digit code → Pair.
In HONE, open Devices → Flipper → Install / update HONE firmware.
Tap Install. Keep the phone next to the Flipper.
The Flipper restarts on its own and HONE confirms the version.

string-array.name: howto_stock_steps
string-array.item: In HONE, open Devices → Flipper → Install / update HONE firmware.
Tap “Switch back to official firmware”.
Connect by USB cable or Bluetooth, as for installing.
Tap Install. Your SD card files stay.
Or use qFlipper on a computer: Install from file / Update.
